question: Should ClickClack replace the paper-and-ember identity introduced in df1137cf with this Switchboard keycap identity?
rationale: Both designs are deliberate and were authored by the same feature owner; repository evidence cannot determine the permanent brand choice without explicit intent.

options.title: Adopt Switchboard
options.body: Confirm the keycap identity as canonical, remove the changelog edit, and land the conflict-resolved branch after refreshed visual verification.

options.title: Retain Paper And Ember
options.body: Keep the current warm identity and close or narrow this PR to reusable non-directional token cleanups.

recommendation.title: Adopt Switchboard
recommendation.body: Confirm the keycap identity as canonical, remove the changelog edit, and land the conflict-resolved branch after refreshed visual verification.
